structure: Part 5, Description of the goods: the 7 traces of description-of-the-goods.fit.spec.js, every one opened and its full action list read, with main-element HTML or text, back link, error summaries and inline errors snapshotted on every page in scope, and the network log read for the prototype's own requests. Trace aliases used in refs: ADD-CATTLE = additional-details-cattle-certification-purpose-and-unweaned-animals.zip (spec line 216, 71 actions); ADD-POULTRY = additional-details-poultry-no-identification-page-and-no-unweaned-question.zip (line 240, 59 actions); CD-CATTLE = commodity-details-cattle-number-of-animals-is-required-and-must-be-a-whole-number.zip (line 33, 97 actions); CD-GERMINAL = commodity-details-germinal-products-weight-packages-and-storage-temperature.zip (line 90, 83 actions); CD-TWO = commodity-details-two-commodities-get-one-block-each-removing-the-last-returns-to-the-search.zip (line 75, 66 actions); ID-CATTLE = identification-details-cattle-one-identification-panel-per-animal-saved-one-at-a-time.zip (line 120, 104 actions); ID-GERMINAL = identification-details-germinal-products-donor-dates-and-identification-mark-with-date-and-length-errors.zip (line 178, 80 actions). No trace recorded an error. Every trace walks notification type (live animals only), origin (France, no region), what are you importing and reason for import (Internal market, Breeding) to reach this section; those pages belong to other parts and are not claimed here. Pages in journey order: (1) Commodity details, /design-release-2.1/consignment-details, always shown, caption 'Description of the goods'; its fields differ by commodity: cattle, horse and pig get Number of animals plus Number of packages (when required), chicken gets Number of animals only, germinal products (cattle semen) get Total gross weight, Number of packages and a Temperature radio group; pointers CD-CATTLE action 40 (clean), 58 (blank error), 72 (zero error); CD-GERMINAL action 32 (clean), 45 (required errors), 58 (invalid errors); CD-TWO action 42 (two commodities), 52 (after removing horse), 53 (after removing pig, back on What are you importing?); ADD-POULTRY action 34 (chicken). (2) Identification details, /design-release-2.1/animal-identification-details, caption 'About the consignment', shown for cattle and germinal products, not for chicken; cattle get one Ear tag + Passport entry per animal saved one at a time, germinal products get one Donor name/ID, Collection date, Production date, Identification number/mark entry; pointers ID-CATTLE actions 44 (1 of 2), 60 (2 of 2), 72 (blank passport), 78 (all saved), 87 (after remove); ADD-CATTLE action 37 (1 of 1); ID-GERMINAL actions 38 (clean), 54 (errors). (3) Additional details, /design-release-2.1/additional-animal-details, caption 'Commodity details', shown for cattle and chicken, not for germinal products; cattle get certification purpose and unweaned animals, chicken get certification purpose only; pointers ADD-CATTLE action 46, ADD-POULTRY action 40. The section exits to Arrival details (/design-release-2.1/arrival-details), which belongs to another part. Integrations: the network log of every trace holds only the prototype's own server-rendered GET/POST page requests and the Prototype Kit's localhost:3011 socket traffic; no data API was called.
